sc_trace.py.local_patch: Insert the vendor directory into sys.path so sibling imports work when subprocesses set PYTHONSAFEPATH.

sc_measure.py.local_patch: Add automatic VRAM preflight and explicit resident/streaming modes. Estimate weights from checkpoint headers because unloaded norms/convolutions can return None from weights_numel(). Streaming loads one top-level module at a time, keeps boundary/capture states and shaping factors on CPU, restores perturbed weights before unloading, and consumes final logits per row. Streaming experiments fan out like exllamav3's conversion/measure_model.py: each module is loaded once per pass, pending perturbed states advance through it and new ones spawn from the cached boundary, chunked into passes by --max-sys; results commit per pass. Auto mode falls back on full-model load OOM; runtime workspace OOMs still propagate. Add deterministic module assignments for N independent GPU workers, canonical-checkpoint resume, and shard completion inventories consumed by ezexl3/sc_measure_parallel.py. Preserve the upstream hash for drift checks.

eval/qbench.py.local_patch: Reuse completed measurements without rebuilding evicted reference logits unless a pending comparison needs them; check reference row files, log cache hits, and commit per-token sidecars before result checkpoints.

eval/qbench/data.py.local_patch: Exclude ezexl3 README bookkeeping metadata and non-files from model source stamps so publication does not invalidate BF16 and every quant; preserve upstream stamp format for cache compatibility. Write result checkpoints atomically.

eval/qbench/engines.py.local_patch: Exl3Backend.run: key the noise generators by activation device. Upstream pins one generator to the compute device, so the noise-floor pass dies on the very first module ('Expected a cpu device type for generator but found cuda'): prefer_cpu modules (the embedding) are loaded on CPU and emit CPU activations. TransformersBackend._noise_hooks already keys generators by device; this makes the exl3 path match. Drop the patch and clear these two fields when upstream fixes it.
